kicker: Getting paid · what a $2,000 invoice becomes
title: Same client. Same $2,000. Different rail.
subtitle: What reaches you, from each company's own fee page, before your bank's charges. Rails that quote the mid-market rate are shown at that rate.

rows.name: Skydo
rows.rule: Flat $19 up to $2,000, plus 18% GST on the fee. Zero FX margin. FIRA included.

rows.name: Wise
rows.rule: Mid-market rate, fee from 0.33% on their India page. Exact fee shown before you send.

rows.name: Payoneer
rows.rule: 1% to receive into a non-local-currency account, then conversion on withdrawal (not shown on the page).

rows.name: PayPal
rows.rule: 7.6% on this payment, as shown in Skydo's own calculator. PayPal's India fee page was unreachable for us.

note: Wise and Payoneer lines show the quoted fee only; conversion on withdrawal can add more. Twelve $2,000 invoices a year through PayPal versus Skydo is roughly ₹1.3 lakh.
